assessment: This article will be of interest to a broad audience of cognitive neuroscientists interested in learning and memory, especially those who study the computations of the hippocampus in human and animal models. This work offers compelling evidence in support of a role for the computations theorized to occur within the hippocampus in category learning more generally. The well-conducted and rigorous computational simulations support the key conclusions and offer a novel theoretical entry into characterizing human learning.
